method: Three points on every shared physical edge, compared between its two incident native triangles. Analytic flood evaluation uses the existing interpolated vertex-normal projection. Encoded samples bilinearly sample the actual 64-pixel WebP cells at the corresponding prepared coordinates. Interior fallback uses a positive-barycentric lattice in each face; unused square-cell pixels are excluded.
limitations: Finite sampling; does not measure screen-space overlap, silhouettes, pixel parity or source observational precision. The Sun direction is irrelevant to these flood-light measurements; directional-shadow counts are omitted.
